description: ConeVersion: A Software for Cone-Penetration-Test Inversion Driven by Machine Learning of Calibration-Chamber Experiments is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Gunjan Rateria, University of Washington-Tacoma Campus (uw.edu). This project presents ConeVersion 1.0, a machine learning-based tool for correcting volume-averaging effects in cone penetration test (CPT) data, particularly in layered soils. These corrections are intended to improve the accuracy of geotechnical applications such as liquefaction hazard assessment and foundation design. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (EXE, XLSX, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-66km-n064. Keywords: CPT,  geotechnical engineering, machine learning, cone inversion, layered soil. Published 2025-05-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
